name: app-dark-trading-chart-crop-with-lime-home-pill-nav-on-stone
title: Dark Trading Chart with Lime Home Pill
whatItIs: A tight crop of a dark phone leaning on pale stone showing a green area chart with a dashed crosshair and price tooltip, time range labels (1W to All), an Options card and a nav where the active Home item is a lime circle with a label beside dark circular icons.
whatItMeans: The tight crop and green glow line make the chart the star, and the expanded lime pill shows the active tab clearly.
techniques: Tight crop on the lower half of the device
Green glowing line with a dashed crosshair
Time range tabs with the selected bold
Nav items as circles with one expanded pill
Pale stone beneath the dark phone
bestFor: Trading and investment app hero crops
Dark UI with a green accent

vocabulary.definition: Dashed lines marking a selected point on a chart.
Labels for choosing a time span such as 1W or 1Y.
An active nav item that widens to show its label.
